title: [Security][Hardening] Validate integration URLs stored in setup tables
summary: Integration endpoint URLs stored in setup tables are now validated against their expected host and scheme before use to prevent credential redirection to malicious endpoints. The validation applies to Pagero, SignUp, Logiq, Shopify, Document Exchange, and Dataverse connectors, falling back to hardcoded values on mismatch.
key_points: URLs must match both host and scheme; https-to-http downgrades are rejected
Malformed stored URLs fall back to hardcoded endpoints instead of throwing errors
Online (SaaS) Document Exchange connections are pinned to Tradeshift; on-premises uses stored URLs unchanged
Dataverse environments must match the configured cloud's trusted host suffix
Shopify validates shop hostname before OAuth authorize and token endpoints
quote: Validate integration endpoint URLs stored in editable setup tables against their hardcoded expected host and scheme before use
